gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Wiry, grinning, and just a bit cheeky in every bent line. Happy Monkey keeps every curve at a flat, unvaried line weight, while ZCOOL XiaoWei, a sans-serif, lets each curve swell and thin gently.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-ibm-plex-sans: IBM Plex Sans cuts a wide channel into every bowl, which gives its text a technical but approachable feel. Happy Monkey brings bent-wire swagger, and the text beneath stays easy to enter.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-aclonica: Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders low and its strokes uniform, with terminals pointing outward. Aclonica, with its deep lowercase, reads at a stretched-out, widely spaced stride.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-alumni-s: Alumni Sans pulls its c open like a bracelet, with only a faint thick-thin shift. Alumni Sans adds slight weight variation that Love Ya Like A Sister, with its constant strokes, lacks.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-arsenal-: Blunt and friendly: Love Ya Like A Sister holds a ballpoint-plain line, while Arsenal SC, a sans-serif, shifts faintly between strokes. Love Ya Like A Sister earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-asimovia: Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders low and its beat level. Asimovian, a sans-serif, stands tall in every lowercase letter, built from a single stroke width, against that low heading.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-basic: Expressive and bold, Love Ya Like A Sister holds every curve unthinned and its ascenders barely above the x-height. Basic reads cleanly, with only a gentle bump up to capitals.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-cal-sans: Cal Sans runs a single stroke width through the whole alphabet, with short ascenders and a tall x-height. Both stay level, but Love Ya Like A Sister is the louder one.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-geist-mo: Barely-there ascenders give Love Ya Like A Sister a squat, bold stance. Beside it, Geist Mono, a monospace, feels structured and technical, its fixed-width, high-rising lowercase marching in rows.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-krona-on: Loud and level, Love Ya Like A Sister sets the tone up top. Krona One, a sans-serif with loosely spaced, cast-iron-tall lowercase, backs it up with sturdy, approachable text underneath.
